title: The Dark Moon
sentences: Days before the final attack, an eclipse darkened the moon.
On May 22, 1453, a partial lunar eclipse rose over the besieged city.
A Venetian doctor inside the walls, Nicolò Barbaro, recorded it in his diary.
Many defenders took it as a terrible omen.
People carried holy icons through the streets and prayed for protection.
Follow for more from the fall of Constantinople.
